correctness.rationale: Published prime-power-square support implies uniform O(sqrt X) reduction to p*k² with p prime; both exceptional p^(4j+1),j>=1 and nonprimitive p|k layers have convergent p-power upper bounds. The strong max_y prime Bombieri–Vinogradov theorem yields the bounded-small-k error after summing over moduli; trivial progression counting gives X log(Q)/K+Q sqrt X large-k tail; choosing K=(log X)^(R+4) and B sufficiently large completes all quantifiers. Verifier independently checks 20000 indices but is not used as infinite evidence.
